ValidationRule.description: This rule triggers when status is changed back to NEW , once the value changes from New to some other value and again New .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case", ISCHANGED( Status ),NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "New")),ISPICKVAL( Status, "New"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status cannot be changed back to New.
